messages:
zoe: uploaded a compact mock of the autoscale mini-dashboard — focusing on the min/max + burst row and the SLO quick-adjust popover. figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-mini

rafa: looks tight, nice use of space. quick thought: the SLO popover currently says 'p95 target' with no unit. change to 'Target p95 latency (ms)'.

dmitri: agree. also the popover has action buttons stacked vertically on small screens which looks cramped. can we move to a horizontal compact row when width < 420px?

clare: accessibility: small-screen layout must keep 44px touch targets. the stacked buttons are more tappable but take too much vertical space; horizontal is fine if spacing preserved.

a11y-bot: lint: contrast issue on .mini-muted at 12px; popover lacks aria-describedby linking to the SLO helper; dynamic updates not in aria-live region.

zoe: noted. heading for popover will be 'Target p95 latency (ms)'. will add aria-describedby to the helper text and aria-live='polite' for forecast text.

rafa: microcopy for forecast: instead of '%', show absolute and percent: e.g., '+$40/mo (+9%)'. users in research responded better to dollar numbers.

dmitri: UX flow question: if user toggles burst on while autoscale is active, do we show any guardrail? runtime can temporarily overcommit — should warn.

clare: yes, show a subtle inline hint: 'If autoscale is increasing, enabling burst may temporarily raise cost.' add a 'Pause autoscale' quick action so user can avoid conflicts.

zoe: good idea. quick CTA text: 'Pause autoscale' (secondary) and primary 'Enable burst'. ensure pause action is lightweight and reversible.

a11y-bot: focus management: when popover opens, focus should go to the first interactive control (SLO input). close button should be last in tab order. respect prefers-reduced-motion for animations.

rafa: visual: the min/max steppers need clear affordance when disabled by guardrail. use 50% opacity + aria-disabled=true so SR announces state.

dmitri: engineering: stepper keyboard behavior should allow shift+arrow for larger increments (e.g., +2) — helpful for power users.

clare: final copy tweak for the guardrail hint: 'Autoscale activity detected. Enabling burst now may increase short-term costs.' keep short and factual.

zoe: action items: update popover header, add aria-describedby & aria-live, change forecast to $ + %, add Pause autoscale quick action, ensure focus order + reduced-motion support, add shift+arrow behavior. will push new frame as 2155551244.

dmitri: I'll wire the API flags for pause and forecast confidence. thanks team :rocket:
